changeNote: We have decided where a prayer room belongs, and started scoring it. Until now we left prayer rooms out of the score altogether, because the old texts place the shrine at the centre of the home while almost every consultant working today places it in the north-east. We now follow the modern reading: the north-east is ideal, the north and the east are fine, and no position counts as a fault — including the centre. Your report still shows you both traditions, and now says which one your score uses.
